# Barovian Calendar

Source: `Chapter 2 - The Land of Barovia/Lore of Barovia.md`.

- Year: 735 B.C. (Barovian Calendar). 12 months of 28 days (336 days).
- Day: sunrise 7:00, sunset 17:00.
- Moon: while the mists remain, the cycle is accelerated, with a full moon every 14 days. The first full moon the party experiences is **Neyavr 8**, the sixth night after they first arrive in Vallaki (Arc C). Later full moons: Neyavr 22, Dekavr 8, Dekavr 22. Earlier ones (Octyavr 22, Octyavr 8) are extrapolated and not stated in the source.

| # | Barovian | Gregorian |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Yinvar | January |
| 2 | Fivral | February |
| 3 | Mart | March |
| 4 | Apryl | April |
| 5 | Mai | May |
| 6 | Eyune | June |
| 7 | Eyule | July |
| 8 | Avgust | August |
| 9 | Sintyavr | September |
| 10 | Octyavr | October |
| 11 | Neyavr | November |
| 12 | Dekavr | December |
